sourceDecisionQuestions.question: Distinguish structural roof deck and sheathing in this source: the archive uses support de couverture and platelage de toiture; decide the pair's trade and regional senses before scoring.

The source distinguishes felt paper from synthetic underlayment; verify whether feutre bitumé adds an unsupported bitumen specification and whether sous-couche consistently names the layer rather than one product.
Confirm contextual and regional French roof-edge terms for drip edge, eave and rake; keep eave edge and rake edge distinct in Reader 6.

The source commands installing the drip edge first, but edge sequence depends on the approved detail and manufacturer; qualified roofing/source review must decide whether this can remain a teaching example without implying a universal sequence.
The source says the foreman orders the crew to unroll underlayment; the archive changes this to asks. Preserve the command force or obtain a source change.

Archived speaking asks a supervisor to confirm installation order, while source speaking asks the learner to point out deck, underlayment and edge on a roof plan. Resolve objective parity before authoring a scored speaking scene.
